title: Rehmannioside D prevents estrogen-deficiency induced osteoporosis by interacting with c-Jun to dismantle the AP-1 complex and suppress MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Wang, Yongli; Wu, Jingtao; Liu, Huabin; Zhang, Yuhao; Sheng, Xiao; Li, Xiongfeng; Gao, Hongliang; Lu, Qian; Ji, Yafeng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Rehmannioside D通过分子对接与实验验证其与c-Jun结合并破坏AP-1复合物，涉及蛋白-DNA互作（AP-1与DNA结合）但非TF-DNA特异性建模，方法以实验为主、分子对接为辅，可借鉴其蛋白-核酸复合物界面研究思路。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Postmenopausal osteoporosis (PMOP) necessitates novel therapeutics with defined targets. Rehmannioside D (RD), a bioactive compound from Rehmannia glutinosa, exhibits anti-inflammatory properties, yet its anti-osteoporotic mechanism remains unclear. PURPOSE: This study integrated network pharmacology with experimental validation to elucidate the efficacy and mechanism of RD in suppressing osteoclastogenesis. METHODS: Potential targets were screened via network pharmacology. In vitro, the effects of RD on RANKL-induced osteoclast differentiation and function were assessed in bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs). Target interaction was verified using Cellular Thermal Shift Assay (CETSA), molecular docking, and Co-IP. In vivo, osteoprotective efficacy was evaluated in ovariectomized (OVX) mice. RESULTS: Network analysis highlighted c-Jun and c-Fos as core targets. In vitro, RD significantly inhibited osteoclastogenesis and resorptive function without cytotoxicity. Mechanistically, RD exerted a dual inhibitory effect: It suppressed the activation of MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways, thereby downregulating NFATc1 expression and inhibiting osteoclast differentiation; Distinctly, RD was identified to interact with and stabilize to c-Jun, sterically hindering its heterodimerization with c-Fos to dismantle the AP-1 complex. This disruption of AP-1 subsequently triggered intrinsic apoptosis, evidenced by an elevated Bax/Bcl-2 ratio and Caspase-3 cleavage. In vivo, RD prevented trabecular bone loss and preserved microarchitecture in OVX mice by reducing osteoclast numbers. CONCLUSION: RD attenuates bone loss via a dual mechanism: it inhibits osteoclast differentiation by suppressing MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling and simultaneously induces mature osteoclast apoptosis by targeting c-Jun to disrupt the AP-1 complex.
abstract_zh: 背景：绝经后骨质疏松症（PMOP）需要具有明确靶点的新型治疗药物。地黄苷D（RD）是地黄（Rehmannia glutinosa）中的一种生物活性化合物，具有抗炎特性，但其抗骨质疏松机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究整合网络药理学与实验验证，以阐明RD抑制破骨细胞生成的功效及机制。方法：通过网络药理学筛选潜在靶点。体外实验中，在骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDMs）中评估RD对RANKL诱导的破骨细胞分化和功能的影响。使用细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、分子对接和免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）验证靶点相互作用。体内实验中，在去卵巢（OVX）小鼠中评估骨保护功效。结果：网络分析突出c-Jun和c-Fos为核心靶点。体外实验中，RD显著抑制破骨细胞生成和吸收功能，且无细胞毒性。机制上，RD发挥双重抑制作用：它抑制MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路的激活，从而下调NFATc1表达并抑制破骨细胞分化；此外，RD被鉴定为与c-Jun相互作用并使其稳定，空间上阻碍其与c-Fos的异二聚化，从而瓦解AP-1复合物。这种AP-1的破坏随后触发内在凋亡，表现为Bax/Bcl-2比值升高和Caspase-3裂解。体内实验中，RD通过减少破骨细胞数量，防止OVX小鼠的骨小梁丢失并保持微结构。结论：RD通过双重机制减轻骨丢失：它通过抑制MAPK/NF-kappaB信号传导来抑制破骨细胞分化，同时通过靶向c-Jun破坏AP-1复合物来诱导成熟破骨细胞凋亡。
